# mtl5_bench capability card -- ryzen-9-8945hs, class large

<!-- Generated by benchmarks/publish_platform.cmake from benchmarks/data/ryzen-9-8945hs/mtl5_bench/20261128T051302Z/.

The platform benchmark's capability cards for the `ryzen-9-8945hs` machine described on the
[benchmark systems](../systems.md) page: every operation family, measured against this
machine's FMA peak and memory bandwidth (#721). This page shows the latest published
`large` session; every session's raw results stay in the data directory.

The standard card is the `medium` class, [ryzen-9-8945hs](ryzen-9-8945hs.md). This page is the
`large` class: larger problems, past more of the cache hierarchy.

Repeatability: 781 of 816 entries within +-5% of the previous session, each session measured after a cold boot on the same commit (median ratio 1.000 to 1.000 per run; benchmarks/compare_sessions.py). Relates to #721, #737 and #885.
